question: Panthi dance form is associated with ______ state of India
solution:
The correct answer is__** Chhattisgarh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Panthi dance **form is associated with** Chhattisgarh** state of India.
 
• It is a folk dance form that originated in the **rural areas of Chhattisgarh** and is performed to celebrate important festivals and occasions.
 
• The dance form is performed by both **men and women** and involves a lot of **acrobatic movements and fast-paced footwork.**
 
• The dancers wear **traditional costumes and use props** like sticks and handkerchiefs to enhance the performance.
 
• The dance form has** gained popularity over the years **and is now performed in various parts of the country and even internationally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharashtra:**

 
 
• **Lavani, Koli, Dhangari Gaja, and Tamasha** are some of the popular dance forms of Maharashtra.
 
• **Lavani** is a combination of dance and music and is performed mostly by women.
 
 
 
• **Kerala:**
 
 
• **Kathakali, Mohiniyattam, and Theyyam **are some of the popular dance forms of Kerala.
 
• Kathakali is a classical dance form that involves **elaborate makeup and costumes.**
 
 
 
• **Punjab:**
 
 
• **Bhangra, Giddha, and Jhumar **are some of the popular dance forms of Punjab.
 
• Bhangra is a** lively and energetic dance** form that originated in the Punjab region.
